sources.title: Neutrino-1 8B · Fermion Research
sources.snippet: Neutrino-1 8B is a local 8.19B-parameter model for chat, tool calling, and OpenAI-compatible applications. The fermion runtime serves it on CUDA, Apple silicon, and x86 from the same 3.88 GB artifact, with streaming and a persistent KV session enabled by default.

sources.title: Introducing the Neutrino-1 models · Fermion Research
sources.snippet: The release contains Neutrino-1 8B, Neutrino-1 0.6B, and Neutrino-1 .6B-Chat. The 8B is the general-purpose model for knowledge, instruction following, and tool use. The 0.6B can run independently or serve as its draft model, while .6B-Chat is post-trained for conversational use.
